thread:
maya: heads up — noticed ~5% bump in ‘unassigned’ leads this morning right after the enrichment job deploy. handoff SLA alerts spiking in the dashboard. anyone else seeing this? :eyes:
liam: saw the alert. digging into the rr assignment logs now. quick guess: enrichment timeout causing leads to skip the rr slot and fall through to unassigned.
olga: could be the new HS enrichment TTL change we shipped yesterday (reduced to 30s). if enrichment takes >30s we mark as failed and the router fast-fails.
hubspot-bot: integration.event: "enrichment_failure" count=72 window=10m source=hs-sync service=lead-enrich v=2.1.4
liam: logs show a burst of 503s to the enrichment service between 09:12–09:18. stack trace points at db replica lag during backlog.
maya: ok — we need a short playbook to keep handoffs within SLA while we fix the enrich backend. proposing: 1) temporary raise ttl to 90s, 2) enable soft-fail that queues lead for rr retry (10s retry window), 3) emit a telemetry tag so we can filter ‘soft-fail’ vs hard. thoughts?
sam: +1 for soft-fail. alternative: route to fallback owner pool (overflow) when enrichment fails instead of leaving unassigned. that keeps sales cadence.
olga: fallback pool is fine but we need to avoid spamming SDRs with bad leads. can we add a quality flag = "pending_enrich" and exclude from immediate outbound until enrich completes?
liam: technically easy — router already supports a metadata flag. patch: set metadata.pending_enrich=true when enrichment misses ttl, then route to overflow with a small holdback (30m). also emit metric: inbound.handoff.softfail.count
maya: can you sketch the quick config change? need a canary and rollback, minimal risk.
liam: patch snippet (will roll canary to 5%):
```
router.config.round_robin: {
  slot_size: 1,
  overflow_policy: "route_on_softfail",
  softfail_ttl: 90
}
```
sam: we should also tweak the heartbeat probe (handoff-heartbeat) to surface lead-count delta per minute so ops sees the delta earlier.
olga: agree. I'll open a small PR to raise ttl and set the pending_enrich metadata, and add the heartbeat delta metric.
maya: assign owners: olga -> config change + telemetry, liam -> canary rollout and rollback play, sam -> overflow pool rules + docs, me -> notify CSMs and update SLA playbook page. target: complete canary in 2 hours, full rollback if errors > 0.5% within 15m.
hubspot-bot: deploy.plan: canary=5% -> scheduled by liam at 09:45 UTC.
liam: starting canary at 09:45. will post status updates.
maya: thanks — quick wins first, long-term we need root cause on db replica lag + add circuit-breaker on enrich calls. also follow-up: test SF mapping fallback so we don't lose owner mapping when enrich pending.
sam: filing a short doc with edgecases and sample queries to find pending_enrich leads in HubSpot. will share link once done. :memo:
maya: perfect. if anyone sees new unassigned spikes after canary go/no-go, @here ping me immediately. :rocket:
